{"language": "python", "code": "import re, os, subprocess
p='website_museum_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()

# extract inline JS
m=re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>', s, re.S)
js=m.group(1)
open('_check.js','w',encoding='utf-8').write(js)

# anchor targets vs ids
ids=set(re.findall(r'id="([^"]+)"', s))
hrefs=set(h for h in re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"', s) if h)
missing=[h for h in hrefs if h not in ids]
print("missing anchor targets:", missing)

# count key features
print("artist data entries:", len(re.findall(r'data-artist="', s)) or js.count('name:'))
print("tiers in JS:", re.findall(r'tier:\s*"([^"]+)"', js))
print("ticket cards:", len(re.findall(r'class="ticket-card', s)))
print("faq items:", len(re.findall(r'class="faq-item', s)))
print("timeline items:", len(re.findall(r'class="tl-item', s)))
print("feature cards:", len(re.findall(r'class="feature-card', s)))
print("artist images in JS:", len(re.findall(r'source\.unsplash\.com', js)))
print("ics filename:", 'artifact-museum-night.ics' in js)
print("Blob usage:", 'Blob(' in js)
print("ESC close:", 'Escape' in js)
print("toast fn:", 'showToast' in js)
"}
